checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.

checks.name: rule_schema_header
checks.detail: RULE: the top-level object has "schema_version": 2 and "generated_by": "log-triage".

final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted the timestamps to UTC in the required format. For each entry, I extracted the service, uppercased the level, took the message after the service name, and captured the last line of any traceback as the exception or null if none. I also summed the repeat counts from any following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. Finally, I aggregated counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.
